translation: Original text of the Shennong Bencao Jing [本經]: Flat azurite [扁青], flavor sweet, neutral. It mainly treats eye pain and brightens the eyes, treats fractures, sprains, abscesses and swellings, and metal wounds that do not heal; it breaks accumulations, resolves poisonous qi, and benefits essence and spirit. Taken over a long time, it lightens the body
